data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to review .gitignore and eclipse.desktop, which caused it to return an 'inconclusive' verdict for the package. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly determined the package is safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore and eclipse.desktop due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: API errors during individual file reviews should trigger automatic retries or fallback mechanisms rather than failing the file and potentially skewing the overall package verdict to 'inconclusive'.

Trivial, non-executable files like .gitignore and .desktop files could be evaluated using lightweight static heuristics instead of consuming LLM context, reducing the chance of API failures and saving costs.
